user.title: Select AlarmMesh sources
user.description: AlarmMesh offers two read-only overviews: combined smoke reports and source information completeness. No smoke reported is not a guarantee of safety. This version does not link alarms, activate sirens, send notifications, or run alarm tests.

data_description.source_entity_ids: Select one or more existing smoke detector entities. A temporarily unknown or unavailable detector can remain selected when its smoke detector metadata is available.

error.no_sources: Select at least one smoke detector.
error.invalid_sources: Select a list of valid entity IDs.
error.duplicate_sources: Select each smoke detector only once.
error.unknown_entity: A selected entity no longer exists. Select an existing smoke detector.
error.wrong_domain: Only binary sensor entities can be selected.
error.wrong_device_class: Each selected entity must have the smoke device class.
error.own_source: Entities provided by AlarmMesh cannot be used as sources.
